short_metadata.title: Why Big Tech is Overrated
short_metadata.description:
Our favorite tech giant just 'optimized' 10,000 human jobs, all to invest heavily in next-gen AI. That 'next-gen AI'? It's a chatbot currently generating groundbreaking recipes like 'Quantum Foam Gazpacho' and 'Sentient Lentil Soup'. Because clearly, trading human expertise for an algorithm that thinks a bisque needs lava rocks is peak corporate innovation. Nailed it!

headline: A multi-billion dollar EV company recalling all cars because the touch screen won't let you roll down the windows

long_metadata.title: The Full Corporate Tech Reality Check
long_metadata.description:
Alright, corporate comrades, listen up:

A multi-billion dollar EV company is recalling all cars because their groundbreaking touchscreen forgot how to roll down a window. That's right, your sleek, silent future-mobile can't even give you a breeze without a massive software patch and probably a new dongle. Welcome to innovation, where basic ventilation requires a nationwide recall.
